quests.title: Contraption-Contrived Cooking Course: Part II

dialogue.t: One wonders if this device may make desserts also...

dialogue.sit: What are you making this time?

dialogue.t: Impeccable timing, Traveler. One just finished ruminating on the making of this next dish — a "pudding," so it is named.
Much consultation did one have with the most recent and popular recipes before deciding on this dish. It is said to be soft and tasty — a fine dessert indeed.
Changes and improvements, too, has one made to it...
...Along with the addition of rice.
Naturally, one's entitlement it is to name this new dish. Mmm... "Rice Pudding" shall its name be.
The quality of the rice is key to this dish. Upon one's activation of the Supreme Cuisine Machine, order it one did to search for high-quality rice. The resulting search led one here.
Well now, Traveler. Since you are presently here, will you help one collect some rice of fine stock? The Machine indicates that it may be found not far from here.
This device needs tending, and one cannot be in two places at once.
Skilled you are in mind and hand, and are thus an invaluable helper. Go forth to one's aid, and one promises that you shall have a share in the Rice Pudding also.
Well then, one presumes upon your aid.
Supreme Cuisine Machine... activate!
Traveler, one has now activated the machine. Follow the tracks it has created and retrieve the Rice that one desires.
Now then, Traveler, pursue the scent one has put you on and retrieve the requisite Rice.
Thank you! You saved my life... I'm Brunn, a merchant.
*sigh* Just my luck. I was originally transporting a batch of cargo...
But... I never expected to get attacked by monsters while I was on my way.
I just kept running, I didn't have time to worry about the goods, or to tell which way I was going... Eventually, I ended up here.
After I got here, I thought I had completely shaken them off. That's why I wanted to get out of the cart and check the goods.
But they suddenly came out of nowhere... Thank goodness for your help.

dialogue.sit: What kind of goods are you transporting?

dialogue.t: I'm transporting a batch of ingredients, rice and stuff like that...
Looks like this is the rice that the adeptus wanted us to find, but it doesn't look like there's much left...

dialogue.sit: Could you sell me some rice?

dialogue.t: You want to buy rice? It's not that I don't want to sell it, it's just that...I basically lost all the goods in my cart on the road when I was running away.
Those monsters must have brought the goods as loot back to their camp.
What a headache. How can I get those goods back? If I can't get them back, I will lose a lot of money...
Traveler... I see that you are very skilled. Can you help me get those goods back?
I—If you are willing to help me, I will give you as much rice as you want!

dialogue.sit: I don't think I can carry so many goods...

dialogue.t: Thank you! I'm counting on you then!
Bring my transport balloon along and place the goods on it.
I'll leave it to you, Traveler. I'll be waiting for you here. After you get the goods, please bring them back to me.
I'll leave it to you, Traveler. I'll be waiting for you here. After you get the goods, please bring them back to me.
These should be the goods we're looking for. Wow, that's a lot of stuff...
Good thing we've got that transport balloon with us, huh? Come on, let's move this cargo back.
Did you bring the goods back? Thank you so much, Traveler!
You wanted... rice, right? Please wait a moment, I will pick rice of better quality for you...
There! This rice is for you, it should be enough.
Thank you, Traveler. I should be on my way now.
I hope I don't meet any more monsters...
Traveler, have you secured the requisite Rice?
Indeed, this is most fine. Just the quality that one needs.
Since the ingredients are readied, one shall now activate the machine.
As before, in your hands shall one leave the heat control, Traveler.
One would have you report your readiness once you are sufficiently prepared.
Are you fully prepared, Traveler?
Then let us begin.
Supreme Cuisine Machine... activate!
Hmm. Ready yourself, then, and inform one once it is so.
One shall entrust the heat control to you, Traveler.
One could not call the heat control desirable...
But no matter. One has ingredients to spare with which to attempt this once more.
Well then. Is the Rice Pudding complete?
Mm, a lovely flavor indeed. No less would one expect of oneself, or one's own Supreme Cuisine Machine. Haha!

dialogue.sit: Let's not get all high-strung here...
How can this machine seemingly do everything...

dialogue.t: Your hand in this matter was mighty also, Traveler. Come. Prepared one has your recipe, as promised.
What then shall one cook next? Hmm...

quests.description: Cloud Retainer seems to want to use this “Supreme Cuisine Machine” to create a new dish…
